stock-pistol-evasive-two-routes.head: 8ee30697
stock-pistol-evasive-two-routes.scope: Stock witnessed level-22 Pistol Evasive from rest, queued 9529 in interlock, typed resistance, and all three owner-only defense records through expiry.

damage.source: GOB 242 stores Ballistic base 5. The incomplete legacy damage range yields the fixed authored health modifier.
damage.runtime: Both routes consume the direct Ballistic value and the recipient's typed resistance.
damage.test: PistolEvasiveAtRestBindsAnEligibleSelectionAndAppliesItsDefensesOnLanding and PistolEvasiveKeepsTheHitAndAppliesThreeDefensesOnlyToItsCaster cover the fixed and typed cases. Stock saw 5 neutral through both routes and raw5/final4 after source1061 added stat181 +20. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/910#issuecomment-7093612297

targeting.source: GOB 242 allows both the timed interlock and ordinary selected-at-rest modes. It requires the Handguns style and a live hostile in range and sight.
targeting.runtime: The cast preserves the selected view and spawn. An interlock outcome requires the original fight and opponent through queue resolution.
targeting.test: PistolEvasiveAtRestBindsAnEligibleSelectionAndAppliesItsDefensesOnLanding, PistolEvasiveQueuesOnlyInTheAdmittedFightAfterItsCast and the shared queue identity cases cover both admissions and target retention. Stock used the same eligible enemy in both routes and saw all 1009/1010/1011 records stay on the caster until expiry. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/910#issuecomment-7093612297

242.note: Native PR910 verified +10 tactic and 9529, plus both timed routes and nine owner-side stat removals. The archived 9530 selection remains open. The executable tests cover the three defense consumers. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/910#issuecomment-7093612297
